Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Amar Murti Shukla, Advocate for 
the petitioner.

State of Uttarakhand.

the counter affidavit has been satisfactorily 
explained. Accordingly, the Delay 
Condonation Application No. 2341/2019 
would stand allowed and the delay would stand 
condoned. Counter affidavit is taken on record.

rejoinder affidavit.
